text: Before you give this a try, if you haven't already, be prepared to pay for the subscription (FYI, educators/researchers, non-profits, and especially students are eligible for discounts) because by the time the (intentionally) generous trial period ends, you won't want to live without it. It's just too convenient and works too well. I've never been a fan of speech-to-text, so I didn't think they'd get me, but I was wrong. My only complaint is that I wish it had full end-to-end encryption.
